messages:
alice-cs: Hey, after upgrading our node SDK to @redwood/inference-js@3.0.0 our embedding requests started 404ing. Example from server:
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/embeddings -> 404 Not Found
{"error":"not_found","path":"/embeddings"}
```
No other deploy changes. Anyone seen this?

ben-support: ugh, thanks for reporting. can you paste the SDK line in package.json and the exact call you're making? also region (no keys) pls.

alice-cs: package.json: ```{"dependencies": {"@redwood/inference-js": "^3.0.0", "express": "^4.18.2"}}```
call (ts):
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
await client.embeddings.generate({ text: 'hello' })
```
we're hitting api.redwood.ai (us-west)

ben-support: ok. quick repro: SDK v3 changed the public API surface. notable changes: paths moved to /v2 and helper method names/param keys were adjusted (expects `input` instead of `text`). if your org's hosted tenant is still on v1, calling the v2 path will return 404. that matches your error.

alice-cs: oh. is there a safe quick fix so we don't roll back everything?

ben-support: two practical options:
1) Pin to the last v2-compatible client: `npm i @redwood/inference-js@2.2.0 --save` and redeploy. fastest.
2) Temporary client override: use the lower-level request and force v1 shape:
```ts
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, apiVersion: 'v1' })
await client.request('POST', '/v1/embeddings', { text: 'hello' })
```
Note: the v3 helper `embeddings.generate` will still marshal `input`, so you'd need to map or call the request path directly.

lucy-eng: tagging infra & SDK. good catch @ben-support. we'll add a clearer server-side 404 message when v3 clients hit v1 tenants and consider a short-term compatibility header. I'll open RW-2401.

deploy-bot: issue created RW-2401 - SDK v3 -> v1 404s. PR draft: https://git.redwood.ai/rw/sdk/pulls/601

lucy-eng: plan: small server shim to return an explanatory body ("SDK/API version mismatch: try downgrading or set apiVersion") + SDK patch v3.0.1 that sets an `x-rw-api-version` hint and logs a more descriptive error. aiming to land within 48h.

docs-bot: I'll add a troubleshooting snippet to the migration guide and a FAQ entry "404 after SDK upgrade" with the pin and override examples.

alice-cs: pinned to 2.2.0 and redeployed 10m ago - embeddings working again. thanks.

ben-support: great. leaving this open until ENG confirms the shim/patch. @alice-cs we'll ping when RW-2401 lands and when the v1->v2 tenant migrations are scheduled.

lucy-eng: noted. also creating RW-2402 to audit SDK release notes for breaking changes around param names. thanks for the repro steps, they made triage quick.
